data.one_liner: Epub parser and writer for Dart, usable on server, web, and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: It can read an EPUB file into memory, expose metadata, chapters, images, and other resources, and write an EPUB back to bytes. The API is synchronous and null‑safe.
use_when: You need to parse or generate EPUB files in a Dart/Flutter app.
You want a pure Dart solution that works on web and desktop without dart:io dependencies.
avoid_when: You need a fully featured e‑book reader UI; this package only provides data, not widgets.
You require advanced DRM or encryption support not covered by the parser.
strengths: Pure Dart, no dart:io, works on web, desktop, and Flutter.
Provides access to all book resources (images, CSS, fonts).
weaknesses: No UI components for displaying books.
Limited to parsing/writing; no navigation or rendering helpers.
data.setup_notes: Add to pubspec dependencies; no special permissions or build_runner needed.
